Manufactured homes are one of the most affordable paths to homeownership, but when hedge funds buy the land underneath those homes, they raise lot fees, sometimes multiple times a year. 

As Governor, I will pass the Manufactured Home Bill of Rights — which my opponent blocked — to protect manufactured homeowners and give them the chance to buy the land under their own homes.

Master Sergeant Max Beilke was an American hero from Minnesota who was killed on 9/11. After serving in Korea he was the last combat soldier to leave Vietnam, and was later instrumental in passing TRICARE for Life and was in a meeting on veteran issues at the Pentagon when it was attacked.

At the newly opened Minnesota Military & Veterans Museum in Little Falls, there is an exhibit dedicated to him – showing the ring he had on 25 years ago. It’s a powerful reminder of Max’s life and service.
posts.summary: Honors 9/11 veteran hero and his legacy in military service

posts.summary: Opposes administration trade war with Canada

posts.text: I’ve opposed these tariffs from the beginning and I was a lead sponsor of bipartisan legislation to overturn the tariffs on Canada that passed the Senate.

posts.text: Congress needs to pass strong kids’ safety rules and make these platforms responsible for the products they build so they stop blaming parents. It’s not the parents. It’s the products.
posts.summary: Demands Congress regulate social media, hold platforms accountable
posts.quote: Congress needs to pass strong kids’ safety rules and make these platforms responsible for the products they build so they stop blaming parents. It’s not the parents. It’s the products.

posts.text: Parents shouldn’t have to fight Big Tech alone. We need rules of the road to hold tech companies accountable and protect kids.
posts.summary: Calls for regulatory rules to protect children from tech platforms
posts.quote: Parents shouldn’t have to fight Big Tech alone. We need rules of the road to hold tech companies accountable and protect kids.

posts.text: I’ve been taking on social media companies for years — from passing the bipartisan TAKE IT DOWN Act to stop the spread of sexually explicit deepfakes on social media to fighting to open the courtroom doors to parents harmed by Meta’s constant push to make money no matter the harm.
posts.summary: Highlights years-long advocacy against social media harms
posts.quote: I’ve been taking on social media companies for years — from passing the bipartisan TAKE IT DOWN Act to stop the spread of sexually explicit deepfakes on social media to fighting to open the courtroom doors to parents harmed by Meta’s constant push to make money no matter the harm.

posts.text: Meta has finally agreed to put in place critical reforms to its platform like time limits on social media and restrictions on push notifications, and it will pay $17 billion for the harm it caused.
posts.summary: Praises Meta settlement as critical protection for children online
posts.quote: Meta has finally agreed to put in place critical reforms to its platform like time limits on social media and restrictions on push notifications, and it will pay $17 billion for the harm it caused.

posts.text:
The recent cyberattacks on Minnesota water systems highlight the urgent need to protect our critical infrastructure.
 
That's why I introduced the Water Cyber Shield Act to help local water systems strengthen their cybersecurity and defend against threats.
posts.summary: Introduces bill to protect water systems from cyberattacks
posts.quote:
The recent cyberattacks on Minnesota water systems highlight the urgent need to protect our critical infrastructure.
 
That's why I introduced the Water Cyber Shield Act to help local water systems strengthen their cybersecurity and defend against threats.

posts.text:
After the cyberattacks on Minnesota water systems, I introduced a new bill to improve water infrastructure cybersecurity and help municipal water systems defend against threats.
 
Protecting Minnesotans & our critical infrastructure is a top priority.
posts.summary: Proposes bill to improve water infrastructure cybersecurity
posts.quote:
After the cyberattacks on Minnesota water systems, I introduced a new bill to improve water infrastructure cybersecurity and help municipal water systems defend against threats.
